metadata.summary: Lewis Hamilton has explained the reasons why he overrode Ferrari's call to pit in the Singapore Grand Prix, a mistake he says he "owned up to" and will work not to repeat - but which would not prevent him from continuing "challenging the norms".

Lewis Hamilton has explained the reasons why he overrode Ferrari's call to pit in the Singapore Grand Prix, a mistake he says he "owned up to" and will work not to repeat - but which would not prevent him from continuing "challenging the norms". Hamilton dropped out of the podium positions to sixth on worn tyres in the closing stages of the last race at Marina Bay after what proved the costly decision not to pit under the Virtual Safety Car, as the Ferrari pit wall had requested. The Addicks academy graduate returned after six years at West Brom, where he had turned down a new deal. "It all aligned at the time and hopefully it's still aligned at the end of the season," he added of why he decided to come back to south London. When Grant left The Valley in January 2019 for Huddersfield, it was not well-received by some Charlton fans. But seven years and three clubs later, the 29-year-old is an experienced and established Championship player.
